clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he used to give away as much as 80% of every paycheck.

Back in the 1980s, when a check came in, he covered rent, groceries and gas first. Whatever was left, sometimes most of it, went straight to a church or a homeless shelter, in cash, handed over anonymously.

He calls it seed faith: give money away expecting nothing back, and the universe gives back more than you handed over.

You can't out-give the universe, he says.

Could you give away 80% of your next paycheck?

#kevintrudeau #givingback #seedfaith #manifestation #generosity #wealthmindset
clips.send: Someone stuck fearing there's never enough sends it to a friend who hoards every dollar, awe at giving away what he couldn't spare.
